Entries.Biography: Jadu is an enigmatic, solitary sentry for the Adventurer's Guild stationed at the Calico Desert. Wearing weather-worn gear suited for harsh climates, he remains quiet and observant, taking satisfaction in vigilant guard duty and rare desert trade.

Camilla.Heading: Camilla
Camilla.Description: Trusts him with special guild errands and scouting assignments.

Marlon.Heading: Marlon
Marlon.Description: Holds professional respect for Jadu's reliability in remote outposts.

Player.Heading: Player
Player.Description: Recognizes the farmer's guild accomplishments with quiet, subtle respect.

SpeechPattern.Heading: Speech Style & Mannerisms
SpeechPattern.Description: Sparse, calm, and detached. Prefers concise statements and rarely engages in small talk.

Solitary.Heading: Distant Observer
Solitary.Description: Prefers watching from afar, thriving in quiet solitude and remote desert posts.

Reliable.Heading: Vigilant Guard
Reliable.Description: Steadfast and focused in battle, finding peace in simple pleasures like fresh desert air after dark cave runs.

Entries.BiographyEnd: Jadu alternates between watching the Calico Desert entrance, offering rare wares, and participating in guild threat assessments.
Entries.Unique: holding desert survival gear or a curved blade
